evidence: Aluminum oxide thin films 10-50 nm thick were grown on a PES substrate in a 12 3 16 in. large traveling wave ALD reactor with nitrogen as a carrier gas in the temperature range of 80-100°C. The sequence of pulses for one cycle deposition of AlOx is TMA (0.5 s)/N 2 (0.8 s)/H 2O (1.43 s) /N 2 (2.5 s).
